Name: Multi Save Checkpoint
Author: NoobSama101
Description:
[b]Multi Save Checkpoint[/b] is a companion mod for [b]Multi Save - Continued[/b]. It lets you create checkpoint-style backup saves manually with one hotkey, or automatically at a configurable interval.

There are two editions:

[list]
[*][b]Standard Edition[/b] — uses Stardew Valley's normal save flow first, then asks Multi Save - Continued to create a backup checkpoint.[/*]
[*][b]QuickSave Edition[/b] — uses QuickSave to capture the current live game state, then asks Multi Save - Continued to create a backup checkpoint.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Choose only one edition.[/b]

Do not install Standard Edition and QuickSave Edition together.

[b]Which edition should I use?[/b]

[b]Standard Edition[/b]

Choose this edition for vanilla, lightly modded, or quality-of-life focused setups.

[list]
[*]Uses Stardew Valley's normal save process.[/*]
[*]Good for vanilla or light mod lists.[/*]
[*]Good for quality-of-life mod setups.[/*]
[*]Does not require QuickSave.[/*]
[*]Manual and automatic checkpoints use the normal Stardew Valley save flow.[/*]
[*]When restored through Multi Save - Continued, loading behaves as a normal Stardew Valley save.[/*]
[*]You start at 6:00 AM, but your saved progress is preserved.[/*]
[/list]
This edition is closer to a [b]safe progress checkpoint system[/b] than a true save-anywhere quickload system.

[b]QuickSave Edition[/b]

Choose this edition for heavier mod lists, QuickSave-compatible modpacks, or players who want to use QuickSave and Multi Save - Continued together.

[list]
[*]Uses QuickSave to capture the current live game state.[/*]
[*]Good for heavy mod lists and QuickSave-compatible setups.[/*]
[*]Good if you already use QuickSave and want Multi Save backup points from it.[/*]
[*]Can restore the live checkpoint automatically when a pending marker is found.[/*]
[*]Requires QuickSave.[/*]
[*]Uses extra safety checks, file validation, rollback support, and restore-loop protection.[/*]
[/list]
This edition is more advanced and more live-state focused than the Standard Edition.

[b]Automatic backups[/b]

Both editions support optional automatic backups.

[list]
[*]Automatic backups are disabled by default.[/*]
[*]You can enable them in Generic Mod Config Menu or the config file.[/*]
[*]The automatic backup interval can be configured from 2 to 15 minutes.[/*]
[*]The recommended interval is 5 minutes.[/*]
[*]Manual checkpoints reset the automatic backup timer.[/*]
[*]Automatic backups wait until the game is in a safe state before starting.[/*]
[*]If the game is busy, in a menu, in dialogue, in an event, in a transition, or otherwise unsafe, the automatic backup waits and retries later.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Important difference[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Standard Edition[/b] saves through Stardew Valley's normal save flow.[/*]
[*][b]QuickSave Edition[/b] saves through QuickSave first, then syncs that state into a Multi Save backup.[/*]
[/list]
Use [b]Standard Edition[/b] if you want the simpler vanilla-save method.

Use [b]QuickSave Edition[/b] if you specifically want QuickSave-based live checkpoints and Multi Save backups together.

[b]Features[/b]

[list]
[*]Create checkpoint saves with one hotkey.[/*]
[*]Optional automatic checkpoint backups.[/*]
[*]Creates Multi Save - Continued backup save points.[/*]
[*]Configurable hotkey.[/*]
[*]Configurable automatic backup interval.[/*]
[*]Optional HUD messages.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/*]
[*]Enable / disable option.[/*]
[*]Detailed SMAPI log messages with clear error codes.[/*]
[*]Compatibility and safety checks for modded setups.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Standard Edition features[/b]

[list]
[*]Uses Stardew Valley's normal save process.[/*]
[*]Keeps normal overnight saves unchanged.[/*]
[*]Tracks the vanilla save menu before creating a Multi Save backup.[/*]
[*]Supports manual and automatic normal-save checkpoints.[/*]
[*]Good for vanilla, lightly modded, or quality-of-life mod setups.[/*]
[/list]
[b]QuickSave Edition features[/b]

[list]
[*]Uses QuickSave to capture the current live game state.[/*]
[*]Supports manual and automatic QuickSave checkpoints.[/*]
[*]Automatically restores a pending live checkpoint marker when loading the save.[/*]
[*]Deletes the live checkpoint marker after restore is confirmed.[/*]
[*]Protects against infinite auto-load loops.[/*]
[*]Validates QuickSave files before syncing.[/*]
[*]Uses temp files, backup files, retries, and rollback support for safer file syncing.[/*]
[*]Blocks checkpoint creation during menus, dialogue, minigames, screen transitions, events, unsafe locations, and non-host multiplayer use.[/*]
[/list]
[b]What this mod does not do[/b]

[list]
[*]The Standard Edition is not a true quickload mod.[/*]
[*]The Standard Edition does not restore your exact tile, second, animation, open menu, event state, or temporary game state.[/*]
[*]Neither edition replaces Stardew Valley's normal overnight save behavior.[/*]
[*]You should not install both editions at the same time.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Default hotkey[/b]

[list]
[*][b]F6[/b][/*]
[/list]
You can change the hotkey through Generic Mod Config Menu or the config file.

[b]Automatic backup default[/b]

[list]
[*]Automatic backups are [b]disabled by default[/b].[/*]
[*]Default interval: [b]5 minutes[/b].[/*]
[*]Available interval: [b]2 to 15 minutes[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]

[b]Standard Edition[/b]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Multi Save - Continued[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]QuickSave Edition[/b]

[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Multi Save - Continued[/b][/*]
[*][b]QuickSave[/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Optional[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — for editing settings in-game[/*]
[/list]
[b]Recommended download choice[/b]

[list]
[*]Download [b]Standard Edition[/b] for vanilla, lightly modded, or quality-of-life focused setups.[/*]
[*]Download [b]QuickSave Edition[/b] for heavy mod lists, QuickSave-compatible modpacks, or if you want to use QuickSave and Multi Save - Continued together.[/*]
[/list]
Again: [b]choose only one edition.[/b]
